title: Multi-molecular adaptations of long-term opioid use in chronic pain
title_zh: 慢性疼痛中长期阿片使用的多分子适应性
abstract: Abstract Millions of chronic pain patients are managed with opioids, yet the neuropsychological implications of stable long-term daily opioid consumption remain unknown. Here, we contrasted the psychosocial profiles and brain structure and function of 70 chronic back pain patients prescribed opioids (CBP+O, average current daily opioid exposure of 7.8 years) with tightly matched 70 opioid-naïve patients (CBP−O) and 30 healthy subjects. Despite CBP+O exhibiting only modestly worse psychosocial profiles and small differences in brain morphology relative to CBP−O, CBP+O showed stark differences in brain activity (ALFF). A large portion (38% of the variance) of this pattern was captured by a model using 19 receptor/transporter distributions. The patients’ (across all 140 CBP) psychosocial profiles were summarized by three principal components (PCs, explaining 70% of variance): functional disability, pain quality, and negative affect. These PCs were respectively associated with serotonergic (5HT1a and 5HT6) and opioidergic (mu-opioid receptor, MOR) receptor-related activities. In additional analyses and new data, 5HT1a- and MOR-related activities tracked opioid dose, abstinence status, and tapering success, while 5HT6-related activity tracked pain intensity. Overall, our findings uncover molecularly defined brain circuits in opioid use and chronic pain.
abstract_zh: 摘要：数以百万计的慢性疼痛患者使用阿片类药物，但长期每日稳定阿片摄入的神经心理学影响仍不清楚。我们将70名处方阿片的慢性背痛患者（CBP+O，平均每日阿片暴露时间7.8年）与严格匹配的70名阿片前无使用史患者（CBP−O）以及30名健康受试者进行对照。尽管CBP+O的心理社会特征仅略逊于CBP−O，且在脑结构上差异不大，但在脑功能（ALFF）上表现出显著差异。该模式的38%方差可由包含19种受体/转运体分布的模型解释。所有140名CBP患者的心理社会特征被三主成分（PCs，解释70%方差）概括：功能障碍、疼痛质量和负面情绪。分别与5HT1a、5HT6和阿片受体（μ-阿片受体，MOR）相关的活动相关联。在进一步分析和新数据中，5HT1a和MOR相关活动跟踪阿片剂量、戒断状态和减量成功，而5HT6相关活动跟踪疼痛强度。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了阿片使用和慢性疼痛中的分子定义脑回路。
